description: Retrieves the balance transaction with the given ID. Use when you need detailed information about a specific balance transaction including amounts, fees, availability dates, and transaction sources.

inputSchema.description: Request model for retrieving a balance transaction.

expand.description: Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. For example, use ['source'] to expand the source field to retrieve full details of the Stripe object that triggered the balance transaction.
expand.title: Expand

id.description: The unique identifier for the balance transaction to retrieve. Balance transaction IDs typically start with 'txn_'.
id.title: Id

inputSchema.title: GetBalanceTransactionRequest

name: get_balance_transaction

FeeDetail.description: Individual fee component breakdown for a balance transaction.

amount.description: Amount of the fee in smallest currency unit (cents).
amount.title: Amount

application.description: ID of the Connect application that earned the fee, if applicable.
application.title: Application

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the fee.
currency.title: Currency

type.description: Type of the fee. Possible values: application_fee, payment_method_passthrough_fee, stripe_fee, tax.
type.title: Type

FeeDetail.title: FeeDetail

GetBalanceTransactionResponse.description: Response model containing detailed balance transaction information.

amount.description: Gross amount of the transaction in smallest currency unit (cents). Positive values indicate charges to customers, negative values indicate funds sent.
amount.title: Amount

available_on.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) indicating when the transaction's net funds become available in the balance.
available_on.title: Available On

balance_type.description: Which balance category this impacts. Possible values: issuing, payments, refund_and_dispute_prefunding.
balance_type.title: Balance Type

created.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) when the balance transaction was created.
created.title: Created

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code in lowercase (e.g., 'usd', 'eur').
currency.title: Currency

description.description: An arbitrary string attached to the object, often useful for displaying to users.
description.title: Description

exchange_rate.description: Exchange rate applied if the transaction involves multiple currencies. Multiply the amount by this to get the amount in the destination currency.
exchange_rate.title: Exchange Rate

fee.description: Total fees charged for this transaction in smallest currency unit (cents).
fee.title: Fee

fee_details.description: Detailed breakdown of all fees paid for this transaction.
fee_details.title: Fee Details

id.description: Unique identifier for the balance transaction object.
id.title: Id

net.description: Net amount of the transaction in smallest currency unit (cents). This is the amount that is deposited into or withdrawn from your balance (calculated as amount minus fee).
net.title: Net

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'balance_transaction' for balance transaction objects.
object.title: Object

reporting_category.description: The reporting category of the transaction for accounting purposes.
reporting_category.title: Reporting Category

source.description: The Stripe object ID to which this transaction relates. This can be a Charge, Refund, Transfer, Payout, or other object. Can be expanded to retrieve full object details using the expand parameter.
source.title: Source

status.description: Current status of the transaction. Possible values: available, pending.
status.title: Status

type.description: Transaction type. Possible values include: adjustment, advance, advance_funding, anticipation_repayment, application_fee, application_fee_refund, charge, payment, payment_refund, payout, refund, transfer, and many others.
type.title: Type

GetBalanceTransactionResponse.title: GetBalanceTransactionResponse
